verdict.rationale: A model catalog with pricing and context-window metadata is a fair capability to ask of a unified LLM API and gateway, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a browsable or queryable model list exposing pricing or context-window data. Spend tracking across 100+ LLMs is a related cost-accounting feature, not a model metadata catalog, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse or query a catalog of available models with pricing and context-window metadata
